scripts.check:security: dotnet run --project tests/MarketPilot.SecurityChecks && node tests/security-hardening-http-checks.cjs && node tests/tenant-security-http-checks.cjs && node tests/webhook-http-checks.cjs && node tests/deployment-http-checks.cjs
scripts.check:tenancy: dotnet build src/MarketPilot.Web && node tests/tenant-security-http-checks.cjs && node tests/tenant-isolation-audit.cjs && node tests/local-access-http-checks.cjs
scripts.check:fulfillment: dotnet run --project tests/MarketPilot.WmsChecks && node tests/fulfillment-http-checks.cjs && node tests/integration-orchestrator-http-checks.cjs
scripts.check:wms: dotnet run --project tests/MarketPilot.WmsChecks && dotnet run --project tests/MarketPilot.WmsLogisticsChecks && node tests/wms-inventory-http-checks.cjs && node tests/wms-logistics-http-checks.cjs
scripts.check:orchestration: dotnet run --project tests/MarketPilot.OrchestratorChecks && node tests/integration-orchestrator-http-checks.cjs && node tests/webhook-http-checks.cjs
scripts.check:sync: dotnet build src/MarketPilot.Web && dotnet run --project tests/MarketPilot.SynchronizationChecks -p:BuildProjectReferences=false && node tests/synchronization-http-checks.cjs
